text:
alex: Kickoff thread for Meridian POC. They need: SDK init sample, streaming with ephemeral creds, function-call example, structured output for transactions, and a small telemetry dashboard for p50/p95 and token counts.

maria_se: Got it. Is SSO required for admin access and ephemeral for backend streams? Any residency reqs?

alex: Yes SAML for admins, ephemeral tokens for services. EU for prod, trial can be US.

tim_infra: Short-lived tokens supported. STS-style endpoint we expose. Example: POST /token with a client-signed JWT -> returns access_token (TTL configurable 15m-1h). Works for websocket streams and function-calls.

ella_devex: I'll assemble a tiny repo with Node + Python snippets: SDK init, stream example, function-call JSON, and a structured schema for reconciliation. Will include troubleshooting tips for auth failures. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

maria_se: Telemetry note: we can show per-route latency (p50/p95) and tokens per request in Console for hosted trials. For Dedicated we can forward to their Datadog via OTLP.

alex: Procurement question: how to model cost for spikey streaming during trial and what dedicated commit to propose for 99% latency SLO?

maria_se: For presales we give two options: (1) PAYG hosted with projected spend based on sample QPS and token rates; (2) Dedicated reserved nodes example (e.g., 2x A100 equiv) with commit discount. I'll draft numbers once we have sample QPS.

tim_infra: Security quick hits: customer-managed keys supported in Private; hosted supports envelope encryption with CMK for enterprise tenants. IP allowlist for tenant/control plane and for Dedicated endpoints. SOC2 report available under NDA.

alex: Cool. Action items: ella -> repo + runbook; maria -> draft pricing calc and security reply; tim -> sample token flow and config TTLs. I'll cc SA when I email the customer.

deploy-bot: Trial tenant meridian-poc created. Console telemetry enabled: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/meridian-poc/telemetry

alex: Thanks team, will sync with customer after runbook lands. :thumbsup:
